page_title: AST 1-0 ARS | Aston Villa v Arsenal 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' The linesman raises his flag. Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
90+5' Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+4' It will be a substitution. Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) is ready to enter the pitch as Oleksandr Zinchenko walks off.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+2' Celebrations are cut short for Arsenal as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
90+1' The Arsenal players joy may have been justified, because referee Jarred Gillett is going use VAR to determine whether there was a handball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jarred Gillett due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Kai Havertz (Arsenal) and his team.
88' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
83' Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Albert Stuivenberg has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) replacing Gabriel Jesus.
81' Dangerous play by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Substitution. Lucas Digne will be replaced by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa).
77' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
77' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
76' The corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is intercepted by the defence.
76' The ball is cleared after Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
73' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to John McGinn (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
71' Two players stand over the free kick. Declan Rice (Arsenal) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
70' Albert Stuivenberg decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli will be replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
70' John McGinn (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

68' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but David Raya blocks the shot with his legs.
66' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Boubacar Kamara and he is replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matty Cash (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for Ezri Konsa.
62' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) will miss the next game.
62' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
61' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and David Raya easily makes the save.
58' A sweet pass inside the box gives Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
57' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) evades everyone and only a last-ditch block right under the bar by a defender prevents a goal.
57' The referee awards a corner and Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take it.
56' Here comes a substitution. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Youri Tielemans.
56' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
53' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt. Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
48' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
47' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Half-time substitution. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is replaced by Moussa Diaby.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The linesman signals that Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45+1' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
43' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.
43' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.

43' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) heads on.

39' Emiliano Martinez was forced into action to thwart Martin Odegaard (Arsenal). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.

36' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
34' William Saliba (Arsenal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
34' Ooh that was close! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
32' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Emiliano Martinez is alert and denies him with a nice save.
31' Flag up against Ben White (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
25' Declan Rice (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
22' The referee blows his whistle as Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was too aggressive in his challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Aston Villa.
19' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jarred Gillett has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
15' Arsenal are seeing far more of the ball now.
12' Jarred Gillett interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
7' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Leon Bailey finds John McGinn (Aston Villa) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the left post. 1:0.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
5' A great run by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
2' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Arsenal will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
